visualization.notes: The United States leads with 392 oncology trials, followed by China with 297, together accounting for nearly 69% of the 1000 total studies. France, Italy, and Spain are the next largest contributors, with 95, 75, and 60 trials respectively, showing a steep drop after the top two countries.
visualization.query_interpretation: User wants to know which countries have the most actively recruiting oncology (cancer) trials. Using query_cond with 'cancer' and filtering for RECRUITING status, grouping results by country for a geographic distribution.
